roles.description: Official standard, law, institution, primary documentation, or authoritative reference within scope.
Original source text, dataset, archive item, record, firsthand publication, or direct documentation.
Scholarly article or reviewed conference/journal publication; claims remain bounded by method and context.
Used to check whether a source, standard, or tool remains current; does not itself license unrelated claims.
Critique or counterevidence; may support claims about the critique itself, not necessarily the world.
Provides diction, object texture, surface, format, or atmosphere only.
Disturbs model prior; may not carry factual claims without being separately upgraded.
Quote-search, DOI/URL/provenance, or selector evidence for a bounded claim.

roles.definition: A source used to keep machine-native forms perceivable, operable, or understandable without flattening the poem.

rule: Factual claims require authority, primary, peer_reviewed, or explicitly justified receipt sources. Texture and entropy are not silent fact witnesses.
